caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical container with a fitted, flat-topped lid. The container appears to be metallic with a surface decorated by intricate patterns of intertwining leaves and floral motifs. The decoration is rendered in muted tones of green, red, and gray, with the red elements accenting the floral shapes that are distributed evenly over the cylinder. The lid is shown as slightly wider than the body, with a thin, beveled edge visible. The container's surface has a reflective quality, suggesting a polished material. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background. There is a faint signature and date in the bottom right corner, reading “J. Howard 1930.”
title: Coffee Can
